description_ru: Клиентка проливает чай на ноутбук и приносит его в мастерскую, где мастер выясняет, можно ли спасти фотографии. Разговор о ремонте и ценах.
text:
Customer: Good afternoon. I think my laptop is dead. Can you help me?
Technician: Of course. My name is Raj. What happened to it?
Customer: Yesterday evening, I spilled a cup of tea on the keyboard. Now the screen is black.
Technician: Oh dear. Did you turn it off immediately?
Customer: No. I tried to dry it with a towel and pressed the power button four times.
Technician: That was not the best idea, but it is a common mistake. Let me have a look.
Customer: How long will it take?
Technician: I need to open the case and clean the inside. Please wait here for about twenty minutes.
Customer: Of course. Is it a big problem?
Technician: I do not know yet. Tea is worse than water because it contains sugar. Sugar is sticky and damages the small parts.
Customer: That sounds terrible. How much will it cost?
Technician: Cleaning is forty pounds. A new keyboard is sixty pounds more. If the main board is broken, it is more expensive.
Customer: Hmm. Maybe I should just buy a new one. How much is your cheapest laptop?
Technician: Our cheapest new laptop is three hundred pounds. They are lighter and faster than most old ones.
Customer: Three hundred pounds is too much for me this month. I only want my old files.
Technician: What is on the laptop? Photographs, documents, music?
Customer: Mostly photographs. My daughter was born two years ago, and I have thousands of pictures of her.
Technician: Did you save them anywhere else?
Customer: No. I know it was silly. I always wanted to do it next weekend.
Technician: Do not worry. The hard disk is usually safe, even when the rest is damaged.
Customer: Really? That is a relief. So you can take the photographs out?
Technician: Yes, and I can also check the old laptop for other damage at the same time.
Customer: That is very helpful. I was afraid that you were going to say everything was lost.
Technician: Sometimes it is, but this is a good case. Yes, I can copy them to a small drive. It costs twenty pounds.
Customer: That is fine. Please do it. Photographs are more important than the laptop.
Technician: I understand. Let me open the case now. Would you like a coffee while you wait?
Customer: No, thank you. I have learned my lesson about drinks near computers.
Technician: That is funny. You are my third tea customer this week.
Customer: Really? Is it so common?
Technician: Very common. People work at the kitchen table, and they put a mug next to the keyboard.
Customer: I did exactly that. I even used my daughter's cup with a picture of a rabbit.
Technician: Hold on. This is interesting. The inside is cleaner than I expected.
Customer: Is that good?
Technician: Yes. The liquid went down the left side, but it did not reach the main board. The hard disk looks perfect.
Customer: So the laptop is not dead?
Technician: Not yet. I need to dry it with a special tool and clean the keyboard. Then I will test it.
Customer: How long does the drying take?
Technician: About an hour, but I want to leave it overnight to be safe. Can you come back tomorrow?
Customer: Yes, I can come at five o'clock after work. Do you need anything from me?
Technician: Your name and your phone number, please. And the password for the laptop.
Customer: My name is Helen Gray. The number is oh-seven-seven-oh-nine, three-three-one, six-six-two. The password is rabbit-two-thousand.
Technician: Thank you, Mrs Gray. I wrote it all down. One more question. Do you want me to keep the old keyboard?
Customer: Why would I want it?
Technician: Some people like to keep them. But I think you do not.
Customer: You are right. Throw it away. Do I need to pay anything today?
Technician: Only the ten pounds for the first inspection. The rest you pay tomorrow.
Customer: Here you are. Thank you for your help, Raj. You are very kind.
Technician: You are welcome. Please do not worry. In most cases, the pictures are safe.
Customer: I hope so. Will you call me if there is a problem?
Technician: Yes, I will call you tonight if I find something serious. Otherwise, I will see you tomorrow.
Customer: Perfect. See you at five o'clock.
Technician: See you then. And please buy a cup with a lid.
Customer: I will. Actually, I will buy a lid for every cup I own.
Technician: That is the best advice I can give. Have a good evening.
Customer: Thank you. Goodbye.

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Долгий звук «и»: губы растянуты, язык высоко впереди; держите его дольше, чем русское «и».
Короткий расслабленный звук между «и» и «ы»; не тяните его и не смягчайте предыдущую согласную.
Рот открыт шире, чем для русского «э»; язык низко и впереди, звук короткий, между «а» и «э».

questions.question: What happened to the laptop?
questions.answer: The customer spilled tea on the keyboard.

How much is the first inspection?
